tasks.title: Inventory actual workspace
tasks.scope: Read-only repository/environment inspection; write inventory artifact only.
steps: Locate the requested Rust repository; read applicable instructions and current Git branch/status.
List running owners/tests and identify unrelated edits before any edit.
Record actual compiler/Cargo, OS, existing crates, tests and configured remotes; classify each as observed or unavailable.
acceptance: Inventory includes baseline commit, dirty-file list and ownership uncertainty.
No claim of missing or completed implementation solely from the supplied work log.
stop_if: Repository inaccessible, competing writer, or ownership of proposed edits uncertain: do not initialize or overwrite.

tasks.title: Map existing code to requirements
tasks.scope: Inventory and traceability documents only.
steps: Map all 58 requirement IDs to existing symbols/tests or explicitly missing/unverified.
Mark equivalent existing functionality for verification instead of duplicate implementation.
Record baseline test commands discovered from repository instructions and their results.
acceptance: Every requirement classified; existing failures retained with logs.
Each planned change has an identified file owner.
stop_if: Existing equivalent code differs materially: resolve contract before replacing.

tasks.title: Freeze first-slice contracts
tasks.scope: Protocol field matrix and first-slice design decisions; no production logic.
steps: Trace pinned handlers AND callers for helo/oleh/ok/quit/chan/host fields, types, requiredness, duplicates and unknowns.
Specify position width/rollover, stream generation changes, reconnect cursor and oversized-header strategy.
Select one supported media fixture and controlled IPv4 peer topology; explicitly exclude unimplemented profiles.
acceptance: Field matrix has source locators and positive/negative fixtures.
No OPEN item needed by the first slice remains implicit.
stop_if: Conflicting sources without a named profile; missing fixture for a required field.

tasks.title: Establish minimal build and dependency DAG
tasks.scope: Existing Cargo workspace and minimum core/app wiring only.
steps: Preserve existing workspace; add only missing first-slice crates.
Pin selected toolchain/dependencies consistent with verified policy.
Check dependency direction; provide adapter contracts below servent.
acceptance: Workspace check/test baseline runs using recorded commands.
No adapter imports concrete servent; no dependency cycle.
stop_if: Dependency or edition change lacks a reason; package access/install requires unavailable authorization.

tasks.title: Implement raw ID and scalar types
tasks.scope: core ID4 and fixed-width scalar helpers only.
steps: Represent ID4 as four bytes; support NUL padding without trimming on decode.
Use explicit little-endian scalar helpers and exact-width validation.
Separate display formatting from wire storage.
acceptance: Tests cover pcp newline, sid NUL, empty/overlong IDs and u16/u32 byte order.
Malformed widths fail without reading outside payload.
stop_if: Host-native representation leaks into serialized bytes.

tasks.title: Implement Atom encoder
tasks.scope: core encoder only.
steps: Encode leaf and parent separately, including empty variants.
Keep ordered duplicate children.
Reject size/count overflow before writing an invalid header.
acceptance: Independent expected bytes match zero-child parent, zero-byte leaf, nested/duplicate cases.
Generic encoder does not impose packet-data cap on all leaves.
stop_if: A round-trip test is the sole evidence of correctness.

tasks.title: Implement incremental Atom decoder
tasks.scope: core decoder and fragmentation tests only.
steps: Retain unconsumed bytes between reads; distinguish need-more, clean EOF and malformed/truncated input.
Decode one tree while leaving following trees buffered.
Use checked lengths and iterative/bounded nesting.
acceptance: Every split position of fixed valid examples yields the same tree.
Concatenated Atoms and EOF at every byte boundary are tested.
Child order and duplicate IDs survive.
stop_if: Decoder allocates from unchecked peer length or treats incomplete input as success.

tasks.title: Enforce layered parser budgets
tasks.scope: core parse budgets and negative tests.
steps: Implement leaf, child, depth, total-node and total-byte budgets independently.
Charge unknown fields and skipped trees to the same budget.
Test limit-1, limit, limit+1 and cancellation cleanup.
acceptance: Each budget rejects only its own invalid case with a stable error.
Deep nesting and many small leaves cannot bypass cumulative limits.
Allocation/retained-input accounting is observable.
stop_if: Budget reset inside a nested child permits unbounded aggregate input.

tasks.title: Implement protocol identifiers and IP conversions
tasks.scope: core conversion functions, no channel hashing yet.
steps: Separate canonical protocol ID bytes, .NET GUID layout and display hex.
Implement complete-byte address reversal for4/16 byte payloads.
Define invalid lengths and IPv4-mapped-address policy explicitly.
acceptance: Non-symmetric GUID fixture matches both layouts.
IPv4 and IPv6 fixed vectors pass; invalid lengths fail.
stop_if: GUID hashing conversion is reused indiscriminately for sid/cid fields.

tasks.title: Implement Station broadcast ID profile
tasks.scope: core Station identity helper and tests only.
steps: Implement SHA512 of .NET-layout BCID, conditional network prefix, BinaryWriter string encoding, MD5 and output GUID conversion.
Keep received ChannelIDs opaque; name this Station profile explicitly.
Obtain independently executed .NET/upstream expected outputs before certifying parity.
acceptance: Empty/Japanese/127-128-byte boundary strings and IPv4/IPv6 tested.
Independent reference outputs agree; review-generated Python examples alone do not satisfy parity.
stop_if: Only the same translated algorithm generated both actual and expected outputs.

tasks.title: Implement raw quit-code preservation
tasks.scope: core errors and protocol mapping table.
steps: Store raw u32/int wire value with optional known interpretation.
Map common quit reasons and observed4000 context explicitly.
Separate local stop reason/retry policy from wire parsing.
acceptance: 1000,1001,1003,1008,1009,4000 and unknown values retain exact raw codes.
Unknown code does not panic or silently become normal shutdown.
stop_if: Code assumes all valid values are1000..1011.

tasks.title: Define actor handles and lifecycle ownership
tasks.scope: core command/event interfaces and minimal worker harness.
steps: Separate running worker from cloneable command handle and status snapshot.
Assign cancellation owner, join path and generation token.
Define terminal outcomes and idempotent stop behavior.
acceptance: Post while worker runs without second mutable borrow or lock across await.
Stale generation events ignored; double stop and shutdown during startup tested.
stop_if: A task is spawned without tracked ownership/join behavior.

tasks.title: Implement content epochs and bounded cache
tasks.scope: core content cache only.
steps: Represent header/body association with stream epoch and transport positions.
Apply both time and byte eviction, with separate header budget.
Account retained allocations, gaps/overlap and restart according to P03 contract.
acceptance: Time-only, byte-only and simultaneous eviction tests pass with a fake clock.
No old-epoch body follows a new header.
Oversized shared backing allocation cannot evade accounting.
stop_if: Missing/oversized header is silently truncated or stale body reused.

tasks.title: Implement subscriber admission and writers
tasks.scope: bounded subscriber queues and fake writers.
steps: Use nonblocking admission in fan-out; per-subscriber writer owns network awaits.
Enforce byte/count/age limits and explicit slow-peer stop.
Release queued buffers on cancellation.
acceptance: One stalled receiver cannot stop a healthy receiver.
Overflow produces one terminal event; memory returns after subscriber removal.
Fan-out complexity is documented as O(N).
stop_if: Channel actor awaits a slow subscriber or queue has no byte budget.

tasks.title: Implement bounded HTTP relay header parser
tasks.scope: pcp HTTP prelude, not direct-player/ingest server.
steps: Parse supported statuses/headers with byte/line/time limits.
Validate channel hex and reconnect numeric fields.
Transfer already-read binary tail into Atom decoder.
acceptance: Header and first Atom in one read work.
Fragmented CRLF, malformed status, oversized header and timeout tested.
404 never enters Atom state.
stop_if: HTTP-to-Atom transition discards buffered bytes.

tasks.title: Implement relay consumer200 path
tasks.scope: pcp client state machine against scripted local peer.
steps: Connect, send selected network profile and cursor, consume200 and perform helo/oleh.
Validate identity/version fields using P03 matrix.
Accept permitted ok/control/chan ordering and preserve unrelated fields.
acceptance: Scripted success, bad SID/version, disconnect and cancellation in each state pass.
No pcnt or redundant raw preamble is sent.
stop_if: Any required handshake field/ordering is guessed rather than in P03.

tasks.title: Implement relay consumer503 and404 paths
tasks.scope: client alternate status branches.
steps: After503 perform helo/oleh before collecting host candidates and quit.
Validate candidates without connecting automatically outside controlled test scope.
Map404/off-air and other statuses to explicit outcomes.
acceptance: 503 transcript includes handshake, host list, quit and close in order.
Empty/invalid candidates and unknown quit values terminate predictably.
stop_if: 503 skips handshake or induces an unbounded reconnect loop.

tasks.title: Implement relay server handshake branches
tasks.scope: pcp server with scripted local clients.
steps: Serve200/503/404 based on channel/slot state.
Perform helo validation and oleh; emit Station-compatible ok1 on accepted path.
Full path sends candidate hosts then appropriate quit after handshake.
acceptance: Each server path tested independently from client to avoid shared-bug agreement.
Slots and resources released on every failure/cancel branch.
stop_if: Client/server tests only connect two copies of the same Rust implementation.

tasks.title: Implement reverse probe and raw preamble
tasks.scope: pcp probe worker and raw preamble codec.
steps: Use pcp newline Atom, observed peer IP and announced port; check returned SID.
Bound connect/read/write and global/per-peer probe concurrency.
Test probe-before-oleh ordering and network-profile differences.
acceptance: Matching/mismatched SID, refused/stalled connection and cancellation tested.
IPv4 probe proven in controlled topology; IPv6 remains separately marked pending.
stop_if: Probe can target an unrelated arbitrary address or is mistaken for NAT configuration.

tasks.title: Connect channel packets to cache and relay
tasks.scope: pcp packet adapter; reuse contract from P03.
steps: Validate head/data types, positions and continuation fields.
Feed epoch/header/body events to cache; split outgoing body safely under16384 bytes.
Relay unknown extensions within budget without corrupting semantic fields.
acceptance: Packet cap boundaries, gaps, restart, metadata changes and fragmented transport tested.
Known fixture bytes are unchanged across relay transport.
stop_if: Oversized header strategy or rollover semantics still undefined.

tasks.title: Prove controlled IPv4 interoperability
tasks.scope: test harness and evidence, production changes only for diagnosed defects.
steps: Pin executable versions/build SHAs of Station and YT separately.
Run both directions for200,503,404, probe and reconnect using controlled endpoints.
Capture sanitized transcripts and hashes; preserve failures.
acceptance: Every required first-slice matrix row passes against both independent peers.
No public YP announcement or unauthorized public traffic used.
stop_if: Reference executable unavailable: mark blocked, never infer pass from source review.

tasks.title: Implement bounded container detection
tasks.scope: format reader interface and first-slice sniffer.
steps: Use a bounded prefix with replay to chosen reader.
Declare supported container/codec subset and ambiguous/unsupported outcome.
Do not consume bytes irretrievably during detection.
acceptance: Short reads, misleading signatures, empty input and unsupported format tested.
Selected fixture reaches its reader with identical bytes.
stop_if: File extension alone selects an unverified parser.

tasks.title: Implement first FLV header/body path
tasks.scope: FLV subset selected in P03; no implicit enhanced-codec support.
steps: Parse header/DataOffset/PreviousTagSize and bounded tags.
Cache relevant metadata and codec configs with epoch changes.
Preserve timestamp/transport distinctions and reject malformed lengths.
acceptance: Fixture includes PreviousTagSize0 and metadata/config ordering.
Audio-only, changed config, truncated/oversized tag tested.
Reconstructed bytes parse in an independent reader/player.
stop_if: 9-byte header alone emitted or extended tags silently treated as supported.

tasks.title: Implement safe-start selection
tasks.scope: format-aware start-point selection.
steps: Use trusted continuation/safe-boundary markers; distinguish packet fragments from frames.
Bound waiting and define audio-only/no-marker fallback or clear failure.
Reset selection on format/epoch change.
acceptance: Interframe-first, fragmented keyframe, audio-only, no-keyframe timeout and restart fixtures pass.
No indefinite waiting or universal IDR claim.
stop_if: cont==0 is treated as proof of H.264 IDR for every format.

tasks.title: Implement direct playback and playlists
tasks.scope: http /stream and /pls adapters.
steps: Validate requested ID; acquire/release subscriber through handle.
Choose version/media-appropriate framing and MIME; escape playlist fields.
Handle client disconnect and on-demand startup/shutdown.
acceptance: Actual player decodes first-slice fixture; slow/cancel paths release resources.
HTTP framing and playlist escaping have negative tests.
stop_if: Chunking applied blindly to HTTP1.0/MMS or playback success inferred from HTTP200.

tasks.title: Define and implement first ingest endpoint
tasks.scope: explicitly selected ingest listener contract.
steps: Choose Station-compatible dedicated URI listener or separately approved/documented Rust /push route.
Specify authorization, binding, channel ownership and supported transfer framing.
Implement bounded POST ingest feeding existing format pipeline.
acceptance: Authorized/unauthorized POST, conflicting bind, cancellation and malformed chunking tested.
ffmpeg/OBS workflow tested only for selected real output protocol and format.
stop_if: A shared /push/{id} endpoint is invented as universal upstream behavior.

tasks.title: Implement TS support independently
tasks.scope: TS parser/fixtures; separate from FLV.
steps: Bound188-byte framing and PSI reassembly.
Handle PAT/PMT changes, continuity/discontinuity and codec startup requirements.
Declare supported codec subset.
acceptance: Changed tables, truncated sections and transport gaps tested.
Independent player decodes late join; PAT/PMT-only success is not enough.
stop_if: No codec configuration/random-access evidence for claimed playback support.

tasks.title: Implement ASF/MMS support independently
tasks.scope: ASF object and MMS framing parser.
steps: Validate GUID/u64 sizes before narrowing and nested traversal.
Distinguish raw ASF object headers from MMS header frames.
Use format-specific response profile.
acceptance: Malformed size/count/truncation and header replacement tested.
Selected reference/player workflow decodes.
stop_if: Assumed50-byte minimum or raw ASF path mislabeled MMS-compatible.

tasks.title: Implement MKV support independently
tasks.scope: MKV bounded parser and fixtures only.
steps: Trace pinned MKV reader and define element/codec subset before code.
Bound variable-length elements/header cache; identify safe cluster/frame starts.
Integrate epoch and cancellation contract.
acceptance: Unknown/oversized/truncated elements and mid-stream startup tested.
Independent decoder/player verifies supported subset.
stop_if: Parser contract not established; do not clone FLV assumptions.

tasks.title: Implement Ogg and decide audio-only scope
tasks.scope: Ogg reader plus explicit MP3 support decision.
steps: Trace Ogg page/header/serial handling and codec identification.
Bound lacing/packet reconstruction and chained-stream state.
Document whether MP3 is supported or deferred with visible capability output.
acceptance: Truncated pages, serial/header changes and audio-only startup tested.
Independent playback validates each claimed codec.
stop_if: Ogg container support is equated with every codec it can contain.

tasks.title: Implement host freshness and failure cooldown
tasks.scope: servent host registry and separate ignored-endpoint table.
steps: Use independent monotonic age/cooldown values and bounded maps.
Expire via access/insertion and scheduled physical cleanup.
Define endpoint identity and session deduplication.
acceptance: Fake-clock tests prove freshness does not accidentally clear failure cooldown or vice versa.
Expired entries release memory and new host updates refresh only appropriate state.
stop_if: Single180-second timer controls unrelated concepts.

tasks.title: Implement named parent-selection policy
tasks.scope: servent selector/retry coordination.
steps: Implement explicitly chosen Station-style weighted randomized policy or ADR-approved alternative.
Validate self exclusion, locality and eligibility independently from score.
Use seeded RNG tests and bounded attempt/reconnect budget.
acceptance: Deterministic fixture selection and distribution/eligibility checks pass.
Not described as universal YT/Station strict hierarchy.
stop_if: LAN subnet assumptions or10-second default appear without source/policy evidence.

tasks.title: Implement bounded gossip forwarding
tasks.scope: pcp/servent broadcast routing boundary.
steps: Apply destination/group/origin eligibility.
Decrement TTL and increment hops with overflow protection.
Define bounded loop/storm suppression policy.
acceptance: TTL0/1/2, local destination, unknown group, hop overflow and repeated input tested.
No forwarding back to excluded source.
stop_if: TTL and hop semantics reversed or dedup map unbounded.

tasks.title: Implement controlled YP announcements
tasks.scope: YP client, local fake directory only initially.
steps: Implement raw PCP profile, channel ownership/refcount and shutdown.
Use30-second reference update policy and error retry1000ms*3/2 capped 30000.
Stop on terminal banned/server-quit/cancel; document jitter if added.
acceptance: Fake-clock update/backoff/terminal-state tests pass.
No announcement remains after final owner removal.
stop_if: Test would announce to a public YP without authorized destination.

tasks.title: Implement directory listing contract
tasks.scope: bounded HTTP index.txt parser.
steps: Obtain representative authorized fixtures and document encoding/columns/escaping.
Bound total bytes, rows and per-field lengths.
Separate listing from PCP announcement connection lifecycle.
acceptance: Malformed rows/encoding/optional columns and response limits tested.
Parsed fixtures match independently checked expected metadata.
stop_if: Column schema or character encoding guessed.

tasks.title: Prove IPv6 and mixed-family behavior
tasks.scope: IPv6 profiles and independent-peer matrix.
steps: Test header1/100 consistency with channel and socket families.
Resolve probe behavior differences with both pinned peers.
Exercise IPv4-mapped addresses and invalid family combinations.
acceptance: Both directions/peers,200/503/probe/reconnect rows have explicit results.
Unsupported configurations reported rather than silently falling back.
stop_if: No usable IPv6 topology: retain blocked status; do not infer pass fromIPv4.

tasks.title: Freeze full RPC/UI contract
tasks.scope: API inventory and UI call-site audit, no UI copying yet.
steps: List actual UI method calls and schemas/access requirements.
Define error, batch, notification and auth behavior per selected compatibility profile.
Map supported/deferred methods to visible capabilities.
acceptance: Each required UI action maps to a tested API contract or explicit unsupported state.
No success stubs.
stop_if: Only method-name parity is available.

tasks.title: Map UI layer boundaries
tasks.scope: frontend dependency map and upstream UI coupling inventory only.
steps: Locate existing frontend framework, assets, network calls, inline handlers and styles.
Assign modules to tokens, components, screens, controllers, API adapter and contracts.
Choose incremental extraction boundaries; preserve existing UI behavior.
acceptance: Every existing API call has an owning adapter/controller path.
Allowed/forbidden imports and the first screen migration are documented.
stop_if: A wholesale rewrite or framework replacement is proposed without demonstrated need.

tasks.title: Implement typed API adapter and view contracts
tasks.scope: frontend API adapter, typed screen models/events and fake transport tests.
steps: Centralize JSON-RPC schemas, IDs, auth, errors and cancellation.
Define view models and semantic events separate from backend wire objects.
Keep permission enforcement in backend; UI availability is informational.
acceptance: Transport/schema/error/cancel tests run without a real daemon.
No component constructs RPC method names; uncertain mutations are not blindly retried.
stop_if: Mock success is used to hide unsupported real API behavior.

tasks.title: Extract presentation controllers
tasks.scope: screen state/use-case controllers, no visual redesign.
steps: Model loading/empty/error/forbidden/disconnected/stale/pending states.
Handle stale reads and duplicate pending actions deterministically.
Bind user intent to adapter calls without parsing labels or DOM layout.
acceptance: Fake-adapter tests cover read races, rejected mutations and uncertain responses.
Controller behavior tests do not require CSS/DOM positioning.
stop_if: Business state derives from colors, labels or component placement.

tasks.title: Create themeable pure presentation
tasks.scope: tokens, presentational components and fixture gallery.
steps: Extract semantic design tokens and local structural styles.
Render representative screens/components from props and emit semantic events.
Add all required state fixtures plus keyboard/focus/responsive/reduced-motion checks.
acceptance: Fixture UI renders with no daemon or network.
Production cannot silently use mock transport on real-backend failure.
Design changes do not edit controller or API modules.
stop_if: Components import transport/domain implementation or accessibility is lost.

tasks.title: Enforce boundaries and prove redesign isolation
tasks.scope: architectural checks and controlled theme/layout exercise.
steps: Add forbidden-import checks matching actual module map.
Apply a second theme and one layout variation through presentation files only.
Run unchanged controller/API tests and identical semantic interaction tests; record backend/contract hashes.
acceptance: Dependency check catches an intentionally forbidden import in its own negative fixture.
Backend/API contracts unchanged across exercise; behavior stays equivalent.
Visual differences reviewed intentionally, not blanket baseline replacement.
stop_if: Functional failure is suppressed by updating visual snapshots or editing backend logic.

tasks.title: Write minimal-context design handoff
tasks.scope: design-change guide and evidence links.
steps: Explain theme/icon/type/spacing/layout/copy edit locations and forbidden change scope.
Trace one read and one mutation from UI to domain.
Record actual validation commands and a small before/after example.
acceptance: Guide points to existing files and runnable verified commands.
Theme/layout/new-behavior tiers are distinguishable without oral context.
stop_if: Guide contains nonexistent paths or claims a test ran without evidence.

tasks.title: Implement secure management API
tasks.scope: rpc adapter and security controls.
steps: Implement read-only methods before mutations.
Apply loopback default, explicit authenticated remote exposure and origin/CSRF checks.
Validate mutation input and redact sensitive logs.
acceptance: Auth/access-category tests, malformed params, unknown methods and CSRF/origin tests pass.
Public relay listener does not expose administrative mutations.
stop_if: Administrative interface exposed publicly by default or secrets logged.

tasks.title: Audit licenses and integrate embedded UI
tasks.scope: web assets/license manifest and UI integration.
steps: Inventory copied source/assets/fonts/dependencies and applicable notices.
Resolve distribution obligations before packaging; seek qualified review if uncertain.
Embed only audited assets and test actual RPC-driven workflows.
acceptance: Asset/license provenance complete; UI flows pass against implemented API.
No remote asset dependency silently breaks offline UI.
stop_if: Reuse/license scope unresolved: do not redistribute assets as cleared.

tasks.title: Implement persistence and lifecycle controls
tasks.scope: configuration/CLI/app lifecycle.
steps: Version configuration, validate before applying, write atomically and preserve migration backup.
Implement controlled bind/config/headless options and OS-specific shutdown.
Bound logs and track task/connection/memory metrics.
acceptance: Interrupted write, invalid config, migration and shutdown during active traffic tested.
Windows andLinux behavior recorded separately.
stop_if: Migration may overwrite user data without recovery or tasks survive shutdown.

tasks.title: Validate target packaging
tasks.scope: build/package scripts and target evidence.
steps: Build selected Windows/Linux artifacts using verified toolchains.
Record dynamic runtime requirements instead of assuming static linking.
Verify embedded UI, config location and clean-machine startup.
acceptance: Each target has artifact hash and startup evidence.
License notices/source-offer requirements handled per completed audit.
stop_if: Cross-compilation alone is offered as runtime verification.

tasks.title: Run parser fuzz and fault campaigns
tasks.scope: controlled test harnesses and scoped defect fixes.
steps: Fuzz supported parsers with bounded resource monitoring and saved seeds.
Inject partial reads/writes, disconnects, stalls and malformed nested structures.
Fix each defect with a regression; rerun affected gates.
acceptance: Campaign duration/seeds/platform and crashes/hangs recorded.
No unbounded allocation/task growth for tested failures.
stop_if: Fuzzer not run or only seed corpus loaded: not a pass.

tasks.title: Run bounded operational soak
tasks.scope: controlled soak and resource report.
steps: Predeclare duration/load/memory-FD-task thresholds and recovery expectations.
Include slow peers, churn, source restart, YP loss and shutdown.
Measure retained memory and cleanup, not just absence of crash.
acceptance: Measured run meets predeclared thresholds; logs identify exact tested build/profile.
Duration stated without translating it into365-day guarantee.
stop_if: Thresholds changed after observing failure without a new explicit run.

tasks.title: Publish evidence-based release assessment
tasks.scope: status matrix and release assessment only.
steps: Reconcile every requirement and test row with current build evidence.
List remaining unsupported formats/peers/platforms/security items.
Prepare small reviewable commits only for verified scoped changes, following repository/user permissions.
acceptance: No required row silently skipped; failures/blockers visible.
No claim of full ecosystem compatibility or automatic main merge.
stop_if: Required gates incomplete: release remains blocked even if implementation checklist is full.
